newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybeans mixed, grains steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybeans mixed, grains steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean values were mixed in reaction to choppy moves at the Chicago Board of Trade, while grains were steady, several U.S. exporters said.

Wheat brokers continued to quote a 22-cent per bushel premium for first half June shipment as harvest was not yet in full swing. Heavy rains doused much of western and central Texas on Friday, slowing harvest progress.
There were more signs of freeze damage as the harvest moved north into Oklahoma, cash sources said. Combines were expected to roll soon in Louisiana and Arkansas.
